text:
max: Heads up — after the model bump to checkpoint v1.5.0 staging p99 for small-batch requests is ~20% higher. Noticing a lot of short prompts now hitting the slow path.
anya: :eyes: can you paste the profiler? is this kernel selection or batching?
max: attaching quick snippet from perf profiler:
```
# hot functions
kernel_selector::choose_kernel  42.3%
kv_cache::lookup             18.7%
attention_op::compute         9.4%
batch_scheduler::fragment     7.8%
```
Seems kernel_selector is picking the dense-float kernel more often.
sam: did the tokenizer change in this checkpoint? longer tokenization could change batch fragmentation.
max: yes — tokenizer moved to the new utf8-encode shim (v2) which emits different token lengths for punctuation-heavy prompts. I ran a quick diff: median seq len increased from 12 -> 18 for our short prompt suite.
rachel: that explains KV hit ratio drop?
max: KV hit rate fell from 0.82 -> 0.67 on staging after rollout. eviction churn looks higher (more unique prefixes).
anya: ok likely two interacting issues: tokenizer emitted longer sequences -> batching heuristics fragment more -> kernel selection chooses path optimized for longer sequences (dense), which is slower for small-batch low-latency flows.
sam: can we force kernel selection to prefer the small-batch kernel as a stopgap? what's the quickest config to flip?
max: yes we can set KERNEL_ROUTE_OVERRIDE=small-batch-stable in model config or pin kernel_selector policy to prefer low-latency kernels for seqlen < 32.
infra-bot: deploy event: rollout model:v1.5.0 to staging at 2026-03-18T09:12:03Z
anya: can someone run the quick bisect? try re-running the staging job with model:v1.5.0 but tokenizer shim reverted (utf8-encode v1) vs kernel policy pinned.
max: bisect plan: 1) pin kernel policy -> measure p99 2) revert tokenizer shim only -> measure p99 3) revert model bump (full revert) if needed. I think (1) should buy time.
sam: commands I'll run locally:
```
# pin kernel route
./infra/tools/update_model_config.sh --model v1.5.0 --set kernel_route=small-batch-stable
# perf-run
./tools/run_latency_suite.sh --env staging --model v1.5.0 --samples 2000
```
ci-bot: perf-check queued: run id 55780 for model:v1.5.0 with kernel_override=small-batch-stable
rachel: if pin fixes p99 we still need a proper fix: either adapt batching heuristics to new tokenizer seqlen distribution or update kernel selection thresholds. Also update evals to include punctuation-heavy short prompts.
anya: agree. I'll open follow-ups: batching heuristic tuning + tokenizer encoding audit + regression test.
max: quick numbers after pin (ran 5x short suites): p99 dropped from 220ms -> 170ms (approx 22% improvement). KV hit unchanged (so tokenizer is primary cause for eviction churn).
sam: great, that means pin as mitigation is effective. Let's prepare a rollout block note and queue a staged rollout with kernel pin while we fix tokenizer/batcher.
max: created revert PR for tokenizer shim (WIP) but prefer not to merge until we have regression tests — going to hold and use kernel pin. PR: https://repo/infra/pulls/4321
anya: I'll draft the ops blurb for the rollout ticket and tag support for monitoring.
max: tagging @rachel for follow-up on long-term: batching heuristic to look at average and tail seqlen per route.
rachel: got it. I'll add a metric for "seqlen-dist-change" in console, and a regression alert if median increases >15% post-rollout.
infra-bot: canary rollout started with kernel_override=small-batch-stable to 10% of staging instances
ci-bot: perf-check result: run id 55780 -> p99=168ms (baseline run id 55712 was 220ms) ; latency regression resolved under kernel pin
max: ok, mitigation worked. Follow-ups: (1) adjust batching heuristics to handle tokenizer shift, (2) add tokenization regression test in CI, (3) consider making kernel selection feature-flagged per model-version to avoid surprises.
anya: assigning tasks: batching heuristic tuning -> sam; tokenization audit + regression test -> max; console metric + alert -> rachel.
sam: will start tuning tomorrow and run local sim harness against v1.5.0 tokenization output.
max: thanks team. leaving the thread open until tokenizer PR or batching fix merges. :thumbsup:
